name: 3D Printing Holes
description: Holes made for 3D printing. Teardrop: turns selected sketch circles into teardrops (45 deg overhang, tip follows the radius) so holes in walls print without sagging.

circles.title: Circles
circles.description: Sketch circles to convert: ids such as "c1" or {id, sketch}. Empty: the circles currently selected.

sketch.title: Sketch
sketch.description: Sketch id or name when the circles are given by id and no sketch is open.

up.title: Up
up.description: Which way is up (where the tip points): auto = world +Z (the print direction) projected into the sketch, or +x, -x, +y, -y, or an angle in degrees from sketch X.

overhang_angle.title: Overhang angle (deg)
overhang_angle.description: Steepest overhang from the horizontal; the tip lies at r / cos(angle) from the centre (45 deg: r * sqrt(2)).

tip_height.title: Tip height
tip_height.description: Override: distance from the centre to the tip, a number in mm or an expression where r is the radius (e.g. "1.3*r"). Empty: from the overhang angle.

flat_top.title: Flat top at
flat_top.description: Optional: cut the tip flat at this distance from the centre, a number in mm or an expression in r (e.g. "r" or "1.1*r"). Empty: pointed tip.
